summary: Phase B (Allocation + sub-admin CRUD + nightly digest) validated end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (17 tests) — 100% pass in 34s (no cold-start hits, seed sub-admins already warm). Frontend: main-admin login (admin@vametra.com / Shiv@12345) lands on /admin-cms with full tab set; Users tab shows 'Allocate' button (data-testid open-allocate) — clicking opens AllocatePanel with pending counters (0 unassigned of 1 pending — the 1 is already allocated to Sakshi), 2 active sub-admin selectable rows (Sakshi + PatniCA + any previously-created QA subs), all form testids present (subadmin-name/email/password/create, allocate-select-<id>, allocate-submit, subadmin-toggle-<id>, allocate-close). Create sub-admin succeeded (qa_phaseb_ui_5873@vametra.com) → success banner shown; toggle click flipped active state. Allocate & notify with Sakshi selected returned the expected 'No pending requests to allocate.' message (unassigned=0). Sub-admin scope verified visually: sakshi@vametra.com sees exactly 1 user (Customer 00002 · Vaibhav Deshmane · TEST_Foobar Inc · NEEDS REVIEW) and NO other tabs / NO 'Allocate' button; patnica@vametra.com sees empty state 'No users have been allocated to you yet.' with 0 users and no other tabs. RBAC verified via backend: sub-admin X-Staff-Token gets 403 on GET/POST /api/admin/subadmins, POST /api/admin/allocate, and GET /api/admin/allocate/pending. Duplicate-email create returns 409; deactivated sub-admin login returns 403; deactivate persists in list. Nightly digest registration verified in source (subadmin.start_pending_digest → AsyncIOScheduler cron hour=19 minute=30 UTC = 01:00 IST; hooked on server startup).

critical_code_review_comments: subadmin.allocate() correctly wraps emailer.send() in try/except so the Resend quota outage does not fail allocation — good.

subadmin.allocate() uses submission _id (Mongo native _id) as the match key; since submissions are inserted with a string _id (uuid) elsewhere this works, but note the API accepts submission_ids as strings — no ObjectId conversion — please keep submission._id string-only in inserts to avoid future divergence.
subadmin.admin_users() aggregates in Python (up to 8000 users + all submissions + overlays) — fine at current scale, migrate to $lookup once user count grows (already flagged in iter51).
AllocatePanel.jsx imports 'PaperPlaneTilt' from @phosphor-icons/react — verify this icon exists in the installed version; no runtime error observed but a fallback icon is safer.
The digest cron is a single-process scheduler — if backend runs multiple workers, guard with a distributed lock or run only on worker 0, otherwise the digest fires N times per night.
